title: Voktty Workspace Kit agent roster
description: Who the agents of a project are, which runtime and host each one uses and which folders each one owns. Shared through Git and edited from Voktty's agent board. Runtime-neutral: each adapter maps these fields to its own command line or session API. Session ids and live state are per machine and never stored here.

forbiddenModels.description: Model id patterns no agent may run on. '*' matches any sequence; matching ignores case. An agent that finds itself on a forbidden model stops and reports instead of working.

messages.description: Message kinds agents may send each other. See team/MESSAGING.md.

projectPath.description: Path relative to the project root, with forward slashes. No '..' segments, no absolute paths. A trailing '/' marks a folder.

readPath.description: A folder the agent may read besides the project. Relative paths resolve from the project root and may leave it (for example a sibling repository). Voktty asks before granting any folder outside the project.

adapter.description: Runtime adapter id. Known adapters are maintained by Voktty; 'generic' runs a command the user approved on this machine and talks to it through the file mailbox.

effort.description: Reasoning effort. Adapters map it to the closest level the runtime supports and report the mapping.

model.description: Model id understood by the adapter. Empty means the runtime's default.

command.description: Only for the 'generic' adapter: the executable to run. Never executed until the user approves it on this machine.

host.description: Where the agent runs. 'local' is this computer; 'ssh:<name>' is the SSH connection with that name in Voktty. Connection details are never stored here: each machine maps the name to one of its own saved connections.

sessionPolicy.description: 'new-per-task' starts a fresh session for every new task (cheaper; the handoff carries the context). 'resume' continues the last session of this agent on this machine.

workspacePolicy.description: 'shared' works in the project checkout. 'worktree' gives the agent its own Git worktree that the orchestrator integrates.

role.description: Role file, relative to the team/ folder.

start.description: Within a separately enabled team, 'always' requests opening with the project and 'on-demand' requests opening on delegation. Installing or reading the roster does not enable a team or authorize a launch.

workdir.description: Folder the agent starts in, relative to the project root. Defaults to the root.

owns.description: Paths this agent may change and commit. Owned paths of different agents must not overlap.
